physicalNotes: Radius 0.58 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Passegger et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 9827 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..22P/abstract): 403,506 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.62 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Passegger et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of GJ 9827 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..22P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4236 +/- 12 K from Passegger et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of GJ 9827 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...684A..22P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
